name: Chat history, selection
summary: Two of four ticked. A counted Delete appears at the bottom right, sized to its label rather than to a fixed width.

looseEnds.title: The checkbox is built from a radio button
looseEnds.detail: The Checkbox instance's only child is a frame named 'Radio Button' holding a check glyph. It draws correctly, but the name will send a developer to the wrong control.
looseEnds.ask: Rename the inner layer, or rebuild the checkbox from its own component.

looseEnds.title: The counted button resizes with its own label
looseEnds.detail: The button is 186px at 'Delete 2 chats', 187px at three and 194px at 'Delete all chats', always ending flush at x=369. The left edge therefore moves every time the count changes, by a different amount at each number.
looseEnds.ask: Is the button meant to grow from the right, or should it hold one width?

constraints.label: Conversation title in selection
constraints.summary: The checkbox takes 40px off the title. The same conversation that cuts at about 37 characters on the normal list cuts at about 32 here.

steps.label: Title width on the normal list
SF Pro Text Regular 15px, average advance

constraints.note: Entering selection re-truncates every row. A user who reads a title in one mode may not recognise it in the other.
